title: Recent Projects
intro: A selection of products and tools I am actively shaping. Each project focuses on a concrete problem, a clear audience, and careful interface decisions.

items.title: The Paguro Journey
items.description: A travel platform for publishing destination guides, stories, and video-led content in a cleaner, more structured way. Built for independent travelers and travel-focused creators. In Development.

items.title: Position Size Calculator
items.description: A focused tool for calculating risk and position sizing quickly before entering a trade. Built for retail investors and traders who want clearer decisions without spreadsheet friction. In Development.

items.title: Recipe Planner
items.description: A planning interface for organizing recipes, ingredients, and weekly meal decisions with less clutter. Built for people who want a simpler way to plan meals and keep ideas structured. In Development.
